description: Regression test for compute_symmetric_difference throwing "not implemented" (a std::logic_error from the anonymous compute_boolean_operation_component in src/boolean_operations.cpp) whenever one component is strictly inside another with no shared boundary at all -- here, shapes_2's 50x50 square sits fully inside shapes_1's 200x200 square, not touching any of its edges. The Union/Intersection/Difference cases already handle this via bridge_components; SymmetricDifference just never got the same treatment despite the surrounding comment already saying to do so.
